scope: Exact fixed-base affine composition, alternating Turan numerator, continuant and continued-fraction coordinates, integral endpoint elimination ideal, all-divisor unit congruence, proper-target admission, and zero-booking verdict

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: The full affine composition from x_2=6/7 gives T_n=(-1)^(n-2)6+4 sum_(j=3)^n (-1)^(n-j)q_(j-1)q_(j-2).

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: The alternating composition numerator is identically T_n=q_nq_(n-2)-q_(n-1)^2, not an independent numerator.

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: q_n=K(7,10,14,...,4n-2) and q_n/q_(n-1)=[4n-2;4n-6,...,10,7], with the n=2 word explicitly equal to (7).

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: For the tail continuant S_n, q_(n-1)S_n is congruent to (-1)^n modulo q_n, and the centered residue satisfies r_n S_n^2 congruent to 1 modulo q_n.

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: For I_n=<7X_2-6,R_3,...,R_n>, with R_j=q_jX_j+q_(j-1)X_(j-1)-4q_(j-1)q_(j-2), the endpoint polynomial q_nX_n-T_n belongs to I_n.

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: The exact integral endpoint elimination ideal is I_n intersect Z[X_n]=<q_nX_n-T_n>.
claims.evidence: report Section 5; rational triangular elimination, primitivity gcd(T_n,q_n)=1, and Gauss lemma

claims.label: PROVED SCOPED NO-GO
claims.claim: Within the base-reaching affine-elimination class, arbitrary polynomial combinations and elimination produce no independent endpoint polynomial beyond q_nX_n-T_n.
claims.scope_limit: does not cover nonlinear nearest digits, inequalities, modular-square estimates, Ostrowski restrictions, or all linear-depth methods

claims.label: PROVED ALL-DIVISOR NONVANISHING
claims.claim: For every Q>1 dividing q_n, T_n and the centered residue r_(n,Q) are units modulo Q, with r_(n,Q) congruent to q_(n-1)^2 modulo Q.

claims.label: PROVED ZERO-SCALE BOUND
claims.claim: The all-divisor unit statement gives only |r_(n,Q)|>=1 and no positive-linear capacity reduction.

claims.label: OPEN
claims.claim: The actual half-bound, stronger Item295 inequality, seed-specific modular-square/Ostrowski theorem, and proper-Q upper construction remain open.

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: The additive centered quotient remains separate from the Item282 common coefficient/product baseline.

claims.label: EXACT FINITE ONLY
claims.claim: The checker replays bounded instances of universal composition, Turan, continuant, matrix, unit, and congruence identities.
claims.scope_limit: no actual half-bound scan, counterexample search, exceptional-prime search, or finite-fit extrapolation
